label: sub_025_sitappa_a_01
text: Oh, hi. This is a home for Team Star dropouts.

label: sub_025_sitappa_a_02
text:
... ... ...
Operation Starfall? You’ve declared war?\c
That’s not really any of our business. It’s not like
we talk to the folks in charge.

label: sub_025_sitappa_a_03
text: Anyway, thanks for coming. Haven’t really got\nmuch to welcome a guest with, but...here.

label: sub_025_sitappa_a_04
text: You can stay and hang here however long you\nlike. If you need to get going, that’s fine too!

label: sub_025_sitappa_a_05
text: This is a home for Team Star dropouts.

label: sub_025_sitappa_b_01
text: We just got tired of Team Star stuff, y’know?\nWe’ve even started going to school on the sly.

label: sub_025_sitappa_c_01
text: Nice to meet ya! And when you go, like always...\nHasta la vistaaarrr! ☆

label: sub_025_sitappa_d_01
text: No one fights here. That’s why it’s such a nice\nplace—better than school, better than with Team\r\nStar, better than home...
